description: No clean concept found. Weak tendency only: fires a bit more often in early-middle game (ply 5-14) right after the opponent's stone lands on the third or fourth row, especially in columns 1, 4 or 5, and when column 4 holds an opponent stone on top of mine at rows 1-2. These cues explain little of the firing. The level flips between consecutive plies as the side to move changes.
effect: None measurable: setting it to max or zero changes every column's move probability by at most 0.02.
notes: 4 score calls. H1 opponent stacked on own stone in col 0/1/4/5: F1 0.06, AUROC 0.52. Col-4 O-over-X pattern: F1 0.086. Last move row 2-3 + ply 5-14 + col 1/3/4/5: F1 0.119, AUROC 0.58, sim share 0.05 (best). The minimal pairs on 4-6 stone positions pointed to col-4/col-1 stacks, but this did not hold on dev games. Level is game-wide and flips with the side to move. Not the engine eval. Steering has no effect. Likely a random direction or a very distributed feature.
